description.text: AI-written synthesis of the official page retrieved in this pass, prepared by the collecting assistant: Stakeholders Search LATEST NEWS & ANNOUNCEMENTS -*- NIQ for Eating Outlets (Cafeteria, Quick Meals Kiosk & Ice-Cream Parlour ) at R&I Park IIT Dellhi FITT is an industry Academia interface organization, established by IIT Delhi to facilitate Research Translation, Technology Development, IPR Management, Technology Transfer & Commercialisation, R&D Collaboration, Start-up Incubation and Mentoring. FITT has adopted several programs to enrich the entrepreneurial eco-system and technology commercialization efforts at the Institute. FITT manages the incubator program at IIT Delhi. Projects addressing technologies at the core and aims at the development of proprietary knowledge in a process, product, software, designs, specific/generic algorithm etc. FITT manages the Intellectual Property and also facilitates the commercialization of IP assets and Know-how of IIT Delhi through technology transfer and licensing. FITT, IIT Delhi's Research and Innovation Park is planned to be a managed facility with focus on innovation and product development where IIT Delhi, industry, entrepreneurs and government agencies interact and enable creation of advanced technological solutions.
